title: Not found page
summary: The "this page doesn't exist" or "you don't have access" screen for a whole page, built on the same shared state markup as pk-states-page's empty state. Works with zero config; add label for a real action button that raises pk-action.

props.name: description
props.description: Explanation. Defaults to "The page you're looking for doesn't exist or you don't have access to it."

props.name: label
props.description: Text for an action button (e.g. "Go home"); no button is drawn when empty. Clicking it raises pk-action - this element never navigates by itself.

slots.name: drawn
slots.description: Internal: the drawn pk-empty-state content and its action button. A light-DOM child this element creates and self-assigns here (never a shadow-root child), so the SDK's on-demand loader can see and upgrade it.

events.name: pk-action
events.description: The label action button was activated. The host decides what happens (navigate home, go back); this element never navigates by itself.

writes.why: A light-DOM element this element creates and owns itself (never a host-given node), self-assigned to its own drawn slot so the SDK's on-demand loader can see and upgrade it (a shadow-root child would be invisible to it).

a11y: Uses pk-empty-state's own role and heading level; the action is a real pk-button in its actions slot.

examples.title: Custom text with a Go home action
examples.html: <pk-not-found-page heading="We can't find that page" description="It may have moved or you may not have access." label="Go home"></pk-not-found-page>
